data.one_liner: Flutter widgets for easily adding gaps inside Flex widgets and scrolling views.
data.what_it_does: Provides Gap, MaxGap, SliverGap, and AnimatedGap widgets to add empty space inside Rows, Columns, and scrolling views without needing SizedBox or Padding.
use_when: You want a cleaner, less verbose alternative to SizedBox inside Columns and Rows
You need gaps inside scrollable views or sliver lists
You want gaps that automatically adapt to the direction of a Flex widget
avoid_when: You do not use Flex widgets or scrollable views
Standard Padding or SizedBoxes are already sufficient for your codebase style
weaknesses: Adds an external dependency for something achievable with built-in widgets
